text: If you leak a little urine when you laugh, sneeze, or cough, and you've been told it is normal, that it is just age, that you should do Kegel exercises and get used to it, you have been lied to. Save this video, because every time I post this, they try to take it down. I see women who come to me embarrassed, wearing pads every day, afraid to laugh out loud, giving up exercise because they are terrified of the leak. Some have been living like this for years. They did the Kegels, they tried the pills, and nothing fixed it, because they were treating the wrong thing. Your bladder is not weak. What is weak is something else that nobody checks. And when I tell you what it is, you will understand why Kegels never worked. The answer is not in your bladder. When your body is inflamed on the inside, everything weakens, the pelvic floor muscles included, and what inflames your body, processed food, toxins, but above all, stress. Chronic stress creates constant inflammation that weakens everything without you noticing. Your muscles lose tone. Your tissues lose firmness. Your body loses strength from the inside out. This is not a bladder problem. This is a body that has been inflamed and exhausted for years. That is why it gets worse no matter what you do. Because the inflammation does not stop. The stress does not stop. And your body has less and less to hold on with. When you clean the inflammation from the root, When you calm the stress that is eating you from the inside, everything changes. The muscles tone themselves. The bladder responds. The leaking reduces. And you stop living afraid to laugh. Write in the comments, My body recovers. If this made sense to you, And if you are tired of living like this, What you need is to learn how to reduce inflammation from the inside And calm the stress that is weakening you. I spent over twenty years learning in silence how to do exactly that. And I put everything inside the way back to stillness. Because every woman deserves to live without fear and without shame. Right now, it is available at a special price. But I do not know for how much longer the link is in my profile.
